description: Use this when someone asks about one Hawaiʻi lot by TMK or street address: zoning and its dimensional rules, State Land Use District, flood zone, Special Management Area, tsunami and sea level rise, lava zone and slope, each with its source. Answers questions about one Hawaiʻi lot, by TMK or street address: what is this parcel zoned and what are the dimensional rules (setbacks, height, lot coverage, density), what the county code lists for adding to the lot (an ADU or a second dwelling), is it in the Special Management Area (SMA), which State Land Use District (Urban, Rural, Agricultural, Conservation), what FEMA flood zone, is it in the tsunami evacuation zone, the 3.2 ft sea level rise flood zone or the Sea Level Rise Constraint District, the wildfire risk, the lava flow hazard zone on Hawaiʻi Island, elevation, slope and aspect, Important Agricultural Lands, soil series and farmland rating, wetlands and streams, historic properties nearby, nearest wells and depth to water, water and sewer service and cesspool records, landslide and dam zones, shoreline setback and vacation rental (TVR) standing on Kauaʻi, tax class and acres. One call returns every finding for the lot, each with its official county, State or federal source, and a permalink to cite.

address.description: Or a Hawaiʻi street address, e.g. 4-1345 Kuhio Hwy, Kapaa

tmk.description: Hawaiʻi Tax Map Key, 9 digits, dashes optional, e.g. 4-4-2-016-063
